resources.string: Each night, choose a player: they are poisoned tonight and tomorrow day.
[ICON: eye_open]The Poisoner points to a player.[ICON: eye_closed] That player is poisoned.[ICON: circle]
The previously poisoned player is healthy.[ICON: circle] \n [ICON: eye_open]The Poisoner points to a player. [ICON: eye_closed]That player is poisoned.[ICON: circle]
You start knowing that 1 of 2 players is a particular Townsfolk.
[ICON: circle][ICON: circle]\n[ICON: eye_open]Show a Townsfolk character token that is in play. Point to two players, one of whom is that character.[ICON: eye_closed]
You start knowing that 1 of 2 players is a particular Outsider. (Or that zero are in play.)
[ICON: circle][ICON: circle]\n[ICON: eye_open]Show an Outsider character token that is in play. Point to two players, one of whom is that character.[ICON: eye_closed]
You start knowing that 1 of 2 players is a particular Minion.
[ICON: circle][ICON: circle]\n[ICON: eye_open]Show a Minion character token that is in play. Point to two players, one of whom is that character.[ICON: eye_closed]
You start knowing how many pairs of evil players there are.
[ICON: eye_open]Show the number (0, 1, 2, …) of pairs of neighboring evil players.[ICON: eye_closed]
Each night, you learn how many of your 2 alive neighbors are evil.
[ICON: eye_open]Show the number (0, 1, or 2) of the Empath\'s alive evil neighbors.[ICON: eye_closed]
Each night, choose 2 players: you learn if either is a Demon. There is a good player that registers as a Demon to you.
[ICON: eye_open]The Fortune Teller points to two players. Nod or shake your head to show whether either player is the Demon.[ICON: eye_closed]
Each night, choose a player (not yourself): tomorrow, you may only vote if they are voting too.
[ICON: eye_open]The Butler points to a player.[ICON: eye_closed] Mark that player with the Master reminder.
Each night, you see the Grimoire. You might register as good and as a Townsfolk or Outsider, even if dead.
[ICON: eye_open]Show the Spy the Grimoire for as long as needed.[ICON: eye_closed]
You do not know you are the Drunk. You think you are a Townsfolk character, but you are not.
You might register as evil and as a Minion or Demon, even if dead.
If you die by execution, your team loses.
If there are 5 or more players alive and the Demon dies, you become the Demon. (Travellers do not count.)
If the Scarlet Woman became the Demon: \n [ICON: eye_open]show the You Are card, then the Demon token.[ICON: eye_closed]
There are extra Outsiders in play. [+2 Outsiders]
Each night*, choose a player: they die. If you kill yourself this way, a Minion becomes the Imp.

[ICON: eye_open]The Imp points to a player. [ICON: eye_closed]That player dies.[ICON: circle] If the Imp chose themself, replace one alive Minion token with the spare Imp token. [ICON: circle] \n [ICON: eye_open]Show that player the You Are card, then the Imp token.[ICON: eye_closed]
Each night*, you learn which character died by execution today.
If a player was executed today:\n[ICON: eye_open]show that player\'s character token.[ICON: eye_closed]
Each night*, choose a player (not yourself): they are safe from the Demon tonight.
The previously protected player is no longer protected.[ICON: circle] \n [ICON: eye_open]The Monk points to a player other than themself.[ICON: eye_closed] Mark that player as Safe.[ICON: circle]
If you die at night, you are woken to choose a player: you learn their character.
If the Ravenkeeper died tonight: [ICON: eye_open]the Ravenkeeper points to a player. Show that player\'s character token.[ICON: eye_closed]
The 1st time you are nominated, if the nominator is a Townsfolk, they are executed immediately.
Once per game, during the day, publicly choose a player: if they are the Demon, they die.
You are safe from the Demon.
If only 3 players live and no execution occurs, your team wins. If you die at night, another player might die instead.
Each night, choose a player (not yourself): their vote counts as 3 votes tomorrow.
Each night, choose a player (not yourself): their vote counts negatively tomorrow.
Each day, after the 1st vote has been tallied, you may choose a player that voted: they die.
If a player of your alignment is executed, you might be executed instead.
You must use a vote token to vote. Dead players may give you theirs. If so, you learn their alignment.
[ICON: eye_open] Wake all Minions so they see each other. \n\nShow the This Is the Demon card. Point to the Demon.[ICON: eye_closed]

Wake the Demon. [ICON: eye_open]Show the These Are Your Minions card. Point to each Minion. \nShow the These Characters Are Not in Play card and 3 good character tokens that are not in play.[ICON: eye_closed]
Each Traveller acts if they are able to act at night.
Wake the Demon and point to the Lunatic.
